conviction_note: The FY26 guide was raised on 2026-09-22, eight days before Q3 closed, and Inderes expects it to be reiterated. That leaves Q3 inside a guide the market already holds, and leaves the order backlog and cash as the unknowns. The findings roughly cancel (sum -0.2). The scaled number is +0.66, from abs 5.5 x p_up 56. The lean comes from the tape: the stock rose on each of its last four reports (+4.9, +6.1, +9.4, +6.8), including the H1 report that followed a pre-release. That reaction history moves p_up and is not filed as a finding, which is why the two measurements differ in sign.

already_public.what: FY2026 guidance raised for the third time: revenue EUR 670-710m, EBITA EUR 32-36m. Basis: projects progressed faster than forecast, data-centre projects, new wins for H2. This implies H2 revenue of 387-427m and EBITA of 21-25m.
CEO Timo Vikstrom to step down by end-2027; search for a successor begins
Second FY2025 dividend instalment of EUR 0.30, ex-date 2026-09-23, paid 2026-10-01

QTS Forssa data-centre earthworks contract signed (value undisclosed) and booked into the Q3 order backlog. Finnish-language press release, not an exchange release. The stock rose 5.3% on 10-21 and fell 4.3% on 10-22.
Inderes Q3 preview: Q3 revenue 210.1m against consensus 201.7m; EBITA 12.3m against 11.5m; EPS 0.99 against 0.94; guidance expected to be reiterated

new_in_release.expect: Q3 revenue and EBITA at or slightly above consensus (201.7m / 11.5m). The 09-22 raise cited faster project progress, so a small beat is more likely than a miss, but the beat sits inside a known guide.
Most likely reiterated at 670-710m / 32-36m. A fourth raise at the release is possible but less likely, because the 09-22 raise came with most of Q3 already known.

Order backlog (Q2: 885.8m). Announced Q3 intake was only about 15m against roughly 210m of revenue, so holding the record needs more than 200m of intake. Forssa and unannounced data-centre and defence work offset part of the gap. A quarter-on-quarter decline is plausible. Direction unknown, leaning down.
H1 FCF was -3.2m, and net debt rose from 35.9m to 52.9m as net working capital unwound from -22.9m to -5.5m. Q3 cash conversion is unknown; risk is to the downside.
First commentary on 2027 and on the scale of the Forssa contract. Inderes says it will ask for both. Direction unknown.

findings.finding: The 09-22 guidance raise (revenue 670-710m, EBITA 32-36m) cited projects progressing faster than forecast, eight days before Q3 closed. That makes a Q3 at or above the 201.7m / 11.5m consensus more likely than not; Inderes sits at 210.1m / 12.3m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Report days: Q3'25 +4.9%, Q4'25 +6.1%, Q1'26 +9.4%, H1'26 +6.8%. The H1 report followed the 06-16 pre-release and still rose (Yahoo daily closes).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the raise was public and the stock rose 11.6% and 5.6% on 09-22 and 09-23. The remainder is the gap between consensus (201.7m) and the run-rate the raise implies. If it were fully priced, consensus would already sit at Inderes' 210m.
findings.independence: The Inderes preview's estimates sit above consensus: https://www.inderes.fi/analyst-comments/kreate-q326-ennakko-odotuksissa-jalleen-uusi-kvartaaliennatys

findings.finding: Order backlog risk. Inderes counts only about 15m of publicly announced Q3 intake against about 210m of Q3 revenue, so the record 886m backlog needs more than 200m of intake to hold. The QTS Forssa earthworks contract (value undisclosed) was booked into Q3 and offsets part of that.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The backlog has hit a record in every recent report (Q1 nearly 700m, Q2 886m), and each was rewarded. A quarter-on-quarter decline has not been tested since the SRV Infra acquisition.
findings.original_quote: Kreate on kirjannut urakan arvon kolmannen neljänneksen tilauskantaansa. (Kreate has booked the contract value in its Q3 order backlog; Forssa release, 2026-10-21)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the only analyst covering the name flagged it, and the stock gave back its Forssa gain the next day (-4.3% on 10-22). The backlog figure itself is not public, and neither is the Forssa value. If the market had priced a decline, the stock would not sit within 9% of its high with zero disclosed shorts.
findings.independence: Forssa booking in Q3, a Finnish press release: https://www.inderes.fi/releases/kreate-ja-qts-yhteistyohon-forssan-datakeskushankkeessa ; Inderes on Forssa: https://www.inderes.fi/analyst-comments/kreatelle-merkittava-datakeskusurakka-forssaan

findings.finding: Guidance was raised three times this year, each time 2-4 weeks before a report (03-30, 06-16, 09-22). The pattern points to a reiteration on 10-26, with a small chance of a fourth raise, because the 09-22 raise came with Q3 mostly known.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance raises moved the stock +8.4% (03-30), +2.6% and then +10.6% (06-16/17), and +11.6% then +5.6% (09-22/23).
findings.why_not_priced: A reiteration is the base case and priced. Only the tail of a further raise, or a narrowing toward the top of the range, is not priced.
findings.independence: Inderes expects a reiteration, with its forecasts in the middle of the range: https://www.inderes.fi/en/analyst-comments/kreate-q326-preview-expectations-for-yet-another-record-breaking-quarter

findings.finding: Cash and working capital. H1 free cash flow was -3.2m (against +15.3m a year earlier), net debt rose to 52.9m from 35.9m at year-end, and net working capital unwound from -22.9m to -5.5m during the growth ramp. Q3 cash conversion is unknown.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 rose 6.8% despite the negative FCF, so the market has looked through cash so far.
findings.why_not_priced: The Inderes preview does not discuss cash. The focus is on revenue, EBITA and backlog, so a weak Q3 cash line would be a surprise rather than a known risk.

baseline_tension: The lean (+0.013) and the flat 20-day run-up are neutral. The 60-day run-up (+36%) shows the guidance raises are in the price, and the findings net to about zero against them, so the hunt neither agrees with nor cuts against the baseline.

lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the reported-quarter finding was cut from +0.5 to +0.3, because Q3 sits inside the 09-22 guide
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': added a cash and working-capital finding at -0.3 from the H1 FCF and net-debt figures
'Size the move on what is new; let reaction history move p_up': abs_move went from 5.0 to 5.5, and p_up from 55 to 56 on four straight positive report-day reactions
